faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SeaSprache AI and how it can transform your business communications

q1.question: How does SeaSprache differ from a traditional chatbot?
q1.answer: SeaSprache provides real-time voice conversations with advanced AI that can understand context, handle interruptions, and deliver human-like responses over the phone. Unlike text-based chatbots, SeaSprache handles actual voice calls with natural speech patterns.

q2.question: How long does it take to set up?
q2.answer: Setup typically takes less than 20 minutes. You can train your voice agent, connect your phone system, set up call rules, and go live in one session.

q3.question: Can callers tell they're speaking with an AI?
q3.answer: Our advanced voice technology creates very human-like conversations. While some callers may notice, most find the experience natural and helpful. You can also customize the AI to introduce itself as an AI assistant if preferred.

q4.question: What happens if SeaSprache can't answer a question?
q4.answer: SeaSprache is designed to handle escalations gracefully. It can transfer calls to human agents, take messages, schedule callbacks, or direct callers to appropriate resources based on your configured rules.

q5.question: How does pricing work?
q5.answer: We offer transparent per-minute pricing. Premium plans include base minutes with additional usage billed per minute. Unternehmen plans are customized based on volume and specific needs.

q6.question: Can I customize the AI's voice?
q6.answer: Ja! You can choose from multiple voice options, adjust tone and speaking style, and even clone custom voices for Unternehmen plans. The AI can be trained to match your brand's communication style.

q7.question: Is SeaSprache multilingual?
q7.answer: Ja, SeaSprache supports conversations in over 10 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, and Japanese.

q8.question: What industries benefit most from SeaSprache?
q8.answer: SeaSprache works well across industries including healthcare, real estate, hospitality, financial services, e-commerce, professional services, and any business that handles high call volumes or needs 24/7 availability.

q9.question: Can SeaSprache handle emergency calls?
q9.answer: While SeaSprache can handle urgent inquiries and escalate appropriately, we recommend maintaining direct emergency protocols. SeaSprache can be configured to immediately transfer emergency-related calls to human operators.

q10.question: Can SeaSprache detect spam calls?
q10.answer: Yes, SeaSprache includes built-in spam detection that can identify and filter suspicious calls, protecting your business from unwanted interruptions while ensuring legitimate calls get through.

q11.question: How do I Loslegen?
q11.answer: Getting started is easy! Eine Demo buchen to see SeaSprache in action, then our team will help you set up your voice agent, integrate with your phone system, and configure it for your specific needs. Most customers are up and running within a day.
